ch01.s01.title: The Kid Who Flunked the Entrance Exam
ch01.s01.summary: A city in the south. A middle-school graduate who meant to be a chemical engineer, with every hope riding on one thing.
beats: In a city in the south there was a middle-school graduate who had flunked the entrance exam and meant to become a chemical engineer.
Back then he wasn't called Gotō yet.
He was crushed, and used games to numb himself out of thinking too much.

ch01.s02.title: The Room of Defeat
ch01.s02.summary: Numb for a while, awake for a while, numb again. The pain grows inward until it becomes an idea.
beats: Numb with games for a while, awake for a while, numb again.
His confidence didn't come back. Neither did the shadow of that thing pass.
A year went by. He didn't get better. He only got quieter.
With no way out, the pain grew inward, into an ever clearer thought.
Maybe there's only one thing that can...... make it stop.

ch01.s03.title: Standing Upstairs
ch01.s03.summary: No lights anywhere; wind down his collar. He swallows his first pack of dextromethorphan.
beats: He feels he is standing on a roof. No lights anywhere; wind down his collar; one step forward and there would be no more pain.
It was his first od — he swallowed a whole pack of dextromethorphan.
The pills were bitter. Life was bitterer.
He can't tell where he is — in that dim room? On the cold, silent high-rise? Or......

ch01.s04.title: Afterglow
ch01.s04.summary: Spring Festivals, galas, fireworks all rush back at once. He sees the afterglow for the first time.
beats: Then he saw his own past — New Year after New Year, noisy galas, fireworks bursting...... countless good thoughts flooded in.
His pupils seemed to give off light, full of longing for life.
He began to feel the whole world was far too interesting. He was happy.
Back then I really did want to die.
But after that one od, the thought turned itself around......
I call it the afterglow. I still want it again.
He realized that if he could make the afterglow fire reliably, he could save more people like himself, standing at the edge.
Before long he began looking for a way to make it fire reliably.

ch01.s05.title: The Days the Repeat Failed
ch01.s05.summary: Kettle, tea leaves, delirium. Amantadine brings no afterglow — only failure.
beats: Maybe I should boil some water. Where's the kettle? Why is the water in the kettle and not the cup...... tea... tea... what is tea for, again?
Amantadine doesn't bring the afterglow. It brings delirium. The repeat failed.
To work out how to trigger it, I kept experimenting. By then I couldn't tell whether I was trying to fix my depression or just wanted to get high.

ch01.s06.title: The Fifth Plateau
ch01.s06.summary: Senses melt, time warps, the self peels away. Letters squirm like worms.
beats: Then, with dextromethorphan, he came to the Fifth Plateau — senses melting, time warped, the self peeled away......
It was dissociative anesthesia. Gotō watched the words on his phone blur, then start to writhe like small worms.

beats.label: The Fifth Plateau: Hold the Words Still

beats: Does the afterglow really exist? He didn't dare answer......

ch01.s07.title: Correcting the Forum
ch01.s07.summary: Guaifenesin is not glycerin. As more people come asking, he starts thinking about harm reduction.

beats.label: Forum Correction: Guaifenesin Has No Glycerin

beats: He knew pharmacology cold and often stepped in to answer questions. As more people came to him, he began to think about harm reduction.

ch01.s08.title: A Day of Forum Answers
ch01.s08.summary: Pregabalin must not be combined with amantadine. Memantine hollows out the brain.
beats: Pregabalin can't be combined with amantadine!
Memantine will hollow out your brain!

ch01.s09.title: The od Group Chat
ch01.s09.summary: Sertraline can't be o'd. The group starts calling him Gotō.

beats.label: Group Chat Triage: Answering One by One Wastes Too Much Time

beats: His WeChat name was Gotō Hitori, so everyone just called him Gotō.

ch01.s10.title: A Stranger from the Forum Sends an Invite: Write Him
ch01.s10.summary: Sakura comes from the forum to invite him into the OverdoseWiki editorial team.
beats: Later a person called Sakura came over from the forum and invited him to join the OverdoseWiki editorial team.

beats.label: Building the Site: The First Homepage

beats: Answering one at a time wastes too much time. If I build a site, everyone can just look it up — much easier! And that's more harm reduction, isn't it?
After that Gotō wrote a great many harm-reduction articles. His effort paid off: a mass of oders began following ODW, and he gained a certain standing in the drug circle.

ch01.s11.title: Restoration
ch01.s11.summary: He writes down three propositions, then walks his own record through them.

ch01.s12.title: Report Seven, Edit Page
ch01.s12.summary: Twenty-six times. He is cataloguing his own abyss.
beats: I gave every one of them a name — first od, second od plus, the trip to hell I didn't wake from, the memory recovery of the afterglow, the repeat that went the opposite way...... twenty-six times. I was cataloguing my own abyss.

He called it a fire — Prometheus stealing fire for mankind. He had been dragged back from the roof once, so he would turn the hand that dragged him into a site, a theory, a guide, so the ones who came after wouldn't have to stand in the wind alone.
They shouldn't have to survive on an accident, the way I did.

ch01.s13.title: Imaginary Root
ch01.s13.summary: The chronicle of twenty-six finished, he stops at the last page.
beats: The chronicle finished; the theory finished; the guide finished. He stopped at the last page and felt he could finally put the thing down.
I can probably...... stop needing it now.

ch01.s14.title: Report Seven: Afterword
ch01.s14.summary: He no longer needs dextromethorphan to get through the day. But he asks: oder, do you want out of the plateau?
beats: I don't know if I'll od again. But one thing is certain: I no longer need dextromethorphan to get through my life. I've probably escaped the plateau.
"oder, do you want out of the plateau?"

beats.prompt: oder, do you want out of the plateau?
